description: This file implements functions for handling registry-controlled domains, including extracting domain and registry parts, checking for registry-controlled domains, and managing domain graph data structures. It is part of the Chromium project and references Mozilla's code as a model.

classes.name: MappedHostComponent
classes.description: Structure representing a host component with original and canonical positions.

methods.name: GetRegistryLengthInTrimmedHost
methods.description: Determines the length of the registry part in a trimmed host, considering rules and exceptions.

methods.name: GetRegistryLengthImpl
methods.description: Calculates the length of the registry-controlled domain within a host, handling dots and special rules.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistryImpl
methods.description: Extracts the domain and registry part from a host string.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistryAsStringPiece
methods.description: Returns the domain and registry as a StringPiece, avoiding copies.

methods.name: AppendInvalidString
methods.description: Appends a string (UTF-8 or UTF-16) as-is to a CanonOutput.

methods.name: DoPermissiveGetHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Permissively computes the registry length, handling canonicalization and invalid components.

methods.name: SameDomainOrHost
methods.description: Checks if two hosts or origins are in the same domain or host.
